use_rsetattr_rgetattr_rhasattr: use rsetattr, rgetattr, and rhasattr to get, set, and check deeply nested object attributes by dot-path string
create_ModelTransform_with_step: create a ModelTransform that runs a function on the model at a specific training step
create_ModelTransform_with_interval: create a ModelTransform that runs a function on the model at a fixed training interval
run_QuantizationAwareTraining_callback: run QuantizationAwareTraining as a PyTorch Lightning callback to quantize a model during training with configurable start and freeze steps
run_PostTrainingQuantization_static: run PostTrainingQuantization with static qconfig to quantize a trained model after fitting with calibration
